description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Information' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Catalog'. It provides methods to manage information entries in an OpenCart-based system, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving information records, as well as managing related descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, layouts, and metadata.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: The 'Information' class manages CRUD operations and related data for information entries in the OpenCart system, including descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, layouts, and metadata.

methods.name: addInformation
methods.description: Inserts a new information record into the database, along with descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layout configurations.

methods.name: editInformation
methods.description: Updates an existing information record and manages related descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: deleteInformation
methods.description: Deletes an information record and all its related descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific information entry by its ID.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Fetches a list of information entries, optionally filtered and sorted based on provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalInformations
methods.description: Returns the total count of information records in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds or updates a description for a specific information record in a given language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a specific information record.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions in the system for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions related to a specific information entry.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions filtered by a specific language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an information record with a specific store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes store associations for a given information record.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all store associations for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves store IDs associated with a specific information entry.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves a list of store IDs associated with a specific information entry.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates an information record with a specific store and layout.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes layout associations for a given information record.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a specific layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Fetches layout associations for a specific information record.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the total number of layout associations for a given layout ID.
